outline: This course provide in-depth knowledge about state-of-art transmission technology. So students can read related technical papers and conduct related research. This is not an introductory course.
schedule:
1.	mobile communication fundamentals
2.	CDMA fundamental
3.	Data detection in for DS/CDMA
4.	MIMO detection
5.	IDMA
6.	OFDMA
7.	UWB
8.	Zigbee
9.	Traffic Theories (optional)
assessment:
口頭報告(1.講義部分章節或2.三年內相關paper含程式): 30%
Final exam (close): 70%
